summary: Devlin Cambeul, 19, went missing in the Arkansas River at La Junta in the early morning after three individuals got in trouble on the water (two were pulled out); multi-day SAR search by Otero County Sheriff, La Junta Fire, CPW, and the US Army Corps of Engineers; a body consistent with Cambeul was recovered June 18 north of the BNSF railyard, ID pending El Paso County coroner
responding_agency: Otero County Sheriff's Office; La Junta Fire Department; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; US Army Corps of Engineers
notes: Name rendered "Cambuel" in CPR copy; body recovered June 18, positive ID pending at reporting; separate unrelated man rescued from same river same morning (no name/date published) | run-899 merge: HOTRR contemporaneous 'search continues' page added
